body.purpose: The system's working text size — tables, forms, buttons, alerts.

label.purpose: Uppercase field names — stat labels, table headers, detail-row labels. Never used for values.

shadows.name: ambient
shadows.purpose: Resting state for cards, stat-cards, and primary buttons.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Dropdowns, modals, auth card, wizard card — anything floating above the page.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default transition for hover/focus/active state changes across buttons, tabs, inputs, cards.

motion.name: ease-panel-rise
motion.purpose: Modal content and auth-card slide-up-and-fade entrance.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Below this: tighter content padding, topbar-brand collapses to auto-width.

breakpoints.name: auth-desktop
breakpoints.purpose: At and above this: the auth/wizard gradient side panel becomes visible.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one call-to-action style in the system. Used for the single most important action on a screen or dialog.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.95rem; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-weight: 550; font-size: 0.875rem; background: #4338ca; color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(16, 24, 40, 0.05); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.16s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #3730a3; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(67, 56, 202, 0.08); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Neutral action alongside a primary button — Cancel, Back, secondary options.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.95rem; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-weight: 550; font-size: 0.875rem; background: #ffffff; color: #14161a; border: 1px solid #d3d8e0; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.16s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f6f7f9; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: A request or item's current state — pill-shaped, color-coded, never solid-filled.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35rem; padding: 0.2rem 0.6rem; border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 650; border: 1px solid transparent; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-badge-success { background: #ecfdf3; color: #067647; border-color: #abefc6; } .ds-badge-danger { background: #fef3f2; color: #b42318; border-color: #fecdca; } .ds-badge-warning { background: #fffaeb; color: #b54708; border-color: #fedf89; }

components.name: Card
components.description: The primary content container — flat at rest, 1px hairline border, optional subtle header strip.
components.html:
Recent Requests
Card content goes here.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid #e4e7ec; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(16, 24, 40, 0.05); overflow: hidden; font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-card-header { padding: 0.95rem 1.25rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #e4e7ec; background: #fafbfc; font-weight: 650; font-size: 0.95rem; color: #14161a; } .ds-card-body { padding: 1.25rem; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #3d434e; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text field — hairline border at rest, indigo border + glow on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { padding: 0.55rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #d3d8e0; background: #ffffff; font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #14161a; width: 100%; transition: all 0.16s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #98a2b3; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #4338ca; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(67, 56, 202, 0.08); }

components.name: Navigation Tab
components.description: Top-bar section tab — muted at rest, white with an underline when active, sits on the dark console-ink bar.
components.css: .ds-nav-tab { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.9rem 1.1rem; border: none; background: transparent; color: #9aa1ad; font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; position: relative; white-space: nowrap; transition: all 0.16s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-nav-tab:hover { color: #e7e9ee; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); } .ds-nav-tab-active { color: #ffffff; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09); font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-tab-active::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0.75rem; right: 0.75rem; bottom: 0; height: 2px; background: #fff; border-radius: 2px 2px 0 0; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: A removable tag — used for selected tags, categories, or filter values.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem; padding: 0.3rem 0.65rem; border-radius: 999px; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #d3d8e0; font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8rem; color: #3d434e; } .ds-chip button { border: none; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; color: #6b7280; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1; }

narrative.overview:
BaseCamp is the operating console for a university's request-and-approval process — MFA-gated logins, priority-level routing, and signed decisions on students' academic and travel records. It reads like an institutional system of record, not a product marketing site: a persistent dark top bar with product identity and section tabs, a calm neutral canvas below, and content organized into flat cards with a single restrained accent. Nothing here is trying to sell or delight on first glance; it is trying to be legible and trustworthy on the two-hundredth glance, because staff and students open it many times a day under real stakes — an approval, an MFA challenge, a certificate that has to be right.

The palette stays almost entirely neutral (grays from near-white canvas to near-black text) with exactly one accent — Institute Indigo — reserved for primary actions, active navigation state, and focus rings. Status color (success/warning/danger/info) is the only other color family, and it is purely functional: it appears on badges and alerts, never as decoration. The one moment of visual richness is the auth/wizard side panel, where a deep indigo-to-navy gradient and a soft dot pattern mark the entry points (login, registration, first-boot wizard) as distinct from the working console beyond them.

Typography is a single family (Inter) carrying the entire hierarchy through weight and size, not through display flourishes — there is no oversized hero type anywhere in the system, because there is no landing-page moment to earn.
keyCharacteristics: One accent color (Institute Indigo) used sparingly against an almost-monochrome neutral field
Flat cards at rest; shadow appears only where something is genuinely raised (dropdowns, modals, hover)
A dark top bar as the one fixed, always-visible piece of chrome — everything else lives in a light, calm canvas
Small, consistent radii (8–14px) and a single restrained 0.16s transition timing throughout
Status color is functional only — reserved for badges, alerts, and state, never for emphasis or decoration

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Institute Indigo is the only color in the system that means "act here." It never appears as a background fill for informational content — only on primary buttons, active state, and focus. If a screen has more than one indigo element competing for attention, that's a bug, not a style choice.

rules.name: The Ink Ramp Rule
rules.body: The three text neutrals (Ink Strong → Ink Body → Ink Muted) form one implicit tonal ramp, continuing through Console Muted, Hairline Strong, and Canvas at the light end. A new gray should slot into this existing ramp rather than introducing an unrelated gray.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: Every weight from body copy to page headlines comes from Inter. A second typeface would read as a second product; hierarchy is weight and size, not family-switching.

rules.name: The Real-Stacking Rule
rules.body: Shadow depth must correspond to actual z-index/overlay behavior. A flat card never borrows the overlay shadow to look "important" — importance is expressed through the one-accent color rule and typography, not borrowed elevation.

dos: Do keep Institute Indigo to primary actions, active state, and focus only — treat any other use as a mistake to fix, not a variant to add.
Do use the existing Ink Ramp (Ink Strong → Ink Body → Ink Muted → Console Muted → Hairline Strong → Canvas) for any new neutral instead of introducing a new gray.
Do scale shadow to real stacking order — flat for resting cards, shadow-lg only for things that actually overlay the page (modals, dropdowns).
Do keep all UI copy in Inter at the four established sizes (headline/title/body/label); don't introduce a new size between them without a real hierarchy need.
donts: Don't use Institute Indigo as a background fill for informational or decorative content — it must always mean "this is actionable."
Don't add a second accent color. Status color (success/warning/danger/info) exists only for state, not for visual variety.
Don't give a resting card a heavy shadow to make it feel "important" — importance comes from the one-accent rule and typography, not borrowed elevation.
Don't introduce display/hero-sized type anywhere in the console. This system has no landing-page moment to earn; the largest text in the app is the 1.4rem page title.
